children: StarHub's M1 deal could catalyze the recovery in Singapore's telecommunications industry as early as 2H next year, RHB Research's Singapore team says in a note. The sector has been facing a price war as operators compete to offer low-price mobile plans, which eat into margins. The RHB analysts are upbeat about the deal, as it could drive scale for StarHub while offering higher-than-expected operating expenditure synergy. Still, the deal faces some risks, they say. For example, the combined StarHub-M1 entity would hold a higher concentration of spectrum--radio frequency bands carrying wireless signals--which the regulator could scrutinize during its review. RHB raises its target price to 1.13 Singapore dollars from S$1.00 and maintains a neutral rating. Shares rise 1.0% to S$1.05. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
